gloss: shyness with strangers; fear of strangers

definitions.gloss: shyness with strangers; being uncomfortable around unfamiliar people
definitions.explanation: The tendency to feel shy, nervous, or uncomfortable when meeting new people. Common in both children and adults.

examples.english: Our child is very shy with strangers.

examples.japanese: {人見知|ひとみし}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm not good at parties because I'm shy around people I don't know.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The baby has started showing stranger anxiety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm shy with strangers, so I'm not good at talking with people I've just met.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (person) + {見知|みし}り (recognizing by sight) - literally 'knowing people by their faces,' hence discomfort with faces one does not know.

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
・{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (verb form: to be shy with strangers)
・{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ / ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (to be very shy)
・{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to show shyness around strangers)
・{人見知|ひとみし}り⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧ + noun (as a na-adjective: {人見知|ひとみし}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧, a shy disposition)

USAGE NOTE:
In Japan, {人見知|ひとみし}り is often mentioned as a personality trait, especially when explaining social difficulties, and adults commonly use it about themselves. It is a mild, non-clinical word: it describes initial awkwardness with new people, not a disorder. For infants, {人見知|ひとみし}り typically begins around 6-8 months and is treated as a normal stage of development.
